messages.title: Thanksgiving Break Reward
messages.body: Happy Thanksgiving! We're thankful for you. Enjoy some coins, materials and Time Skips to build up your camp over the break.

messages.title: Welcome to Egg Escape!
messages.body: Thanks for playing! Here's a little gift to get you started: coins, plus Tier Skips to climb the Battle Pass faster.

messages.title: Happy Thanksgiving!
messages.body: Wishing you a warm Thanksgiving. Here's a gift of coins and materials to spend at camp. Thank you for playing Egg Escape!

messages.title: A Black Friday Gift
messages.body: No rush and no catch, just a thank-you from us. Enjoy some coins and materials for your camp.

messages.title: A Cyber Monday Treat
messages.body: Hope your week is off to a cozy start. Here's a bundle of boosters: Bombs, Any Pieces and Rocks, to help free more critters.
